question.text: The maximum number of atoms that can be in one plane in the molecule p-nitrobenzonitrile are

solution.text: All atoms are on the same plane as all central atoms are either $\mathrm{sp}^{2}$ or sp hybridised $\therefore$ total number of atoms on same plane $\Rightarrow \mathrm{C}_{6} \mathrm{H}_{4}+\mathrm{NO}_{2}+\mathrm{CN}=15$
